entries.ruling: docs/law/client-architecture-lockdown.md §4.4: the shell scrim is shell-region paint, a full-bleed dimmer the stylesheet positions and fades; it is a pointer-only dismiss surface (the keyboard closes a sheet with Escape), so a Button's focus ring, hit area and label ink would be wrong on it
docs/law/client-architecture-lockdown.md §0 item 2: the trail's flex basis and its gap compensation are measured from the rendered row at runtime
docs/law/client-architecture-lockdown.md §0 item 2 governs CSS style props only: `style` on `StylePreview` and `ChatStyleDiagram` is a ChatStyle id, not CSS
docs/law/client-architecture-lockdown.md §0 item 2: the band fill is the colour the room's art data carries, read at runtime

docs/law/client-architecture-lockdown.md §0 item 2: the avatar column's reserve is computed from the room's portrait count at runtime, stamped on the box that holds the stack as packages/ui/src/primitives/avatar-stack/geometry.ts `avatarStackInlineSize` directs
docs/law/client-architecture-lockdown.md §0 item 2: the frame's aspect ratio and width come from the open image and the measured dialog at runtime
docs/law/client-architecture-lockdown.md §0 item 2: the edited row holds the inline and block size it measured before the edit began

docs/law/client-architecture-lockdown.md §0 item 2: the avatar column's reserve is computed from the roster's member count at runtime, stamped on the box that holds the stack as packages/ui/src/primitives/avatar-stack/geometry.ts `avatarStackInlineSize` directs
